segments.text: Cold pavement, mental basement.
Stuck in the cycle of displacement.
I saw the ghosts in the streetlights.
Chasing the glory through deep nights.
Every bruise on the skin is a lesson I learned to live in.
Before the vision was clear, I was fighting the shadow and fear.
Hard work in the dark, lighting the spark.
Leaving my mark, calculated steps.
Counting the reps, rising from depths.
Bring the truth.
Bring the scars.
Bring the night into the stars.
They want the shine, not the scars.
I bring both.
KTD in the frame.
Let the whole world know.
Let the whole world know.
I turned the gravel into gold.
A story that hasn't been told.
The pressure was heavy, I held it.
A champion's heart when I felt it.
Now the blueprint is set.
Paying the debt, nothing to regret.
From the shadows to the light.
Taking the flight, claiming my right.
Every scar is a map of the path.
Dodging the wrath, counting the math.
I built a kingdom crude from dust.
In the hustle, I put all my trust.
Was it worth the blood?
Was it worth the rain?
Was it worth the years I buried the pain?
Looking at the mirror, seeing a king.
But still feeling the sting of everything.
Yeah, I still feel the sting.
